	setTheme(themeName) {
		if (this.themes[themeName]) {
			storeValue("activeTheme", themeName);
			storeValue("theme", this.themes[themeName]);
		}
	},

	getThemeOptions() {
		return Object.keys(this.themes).map(name => ({

			value: name
		}));
	}

actionConfiguration.body:
function (raw) {
  const get = (...keys) => {
    for (const k of keys) {
      if (raw[k] !== undefined && raw[k] !== null && raw[k] !== "") return raw[k];
      const found = Object.keys(raw).find(rk => rk.toLowerCase() === k.toLowerCase());
      if (found && raw[found] !== "") return raw[found];
    }
    return undefined;
  };
  return {
    invoice_id: get("invoice_id"),
    invoice_number: get("invoice_number"),
    invoice_date: get("invoice_date"),
    customer_id: get("customer_id"),
    customer_name: get("customer_name"),
    customer_address: get("customer_address", "address"),
    district: get("district"),
    pin_code: get("pin_code", "pincode", "pin"),
    gstin: get("gstin", "gst_number"),
    customer_phone: get("customer_phone", "phone"),
    customer_email: get("customer_email", "email"),
    dse_name: get("dse_name", "dse"),
    dse_phone: get("dse_phone"),
    route: get("route"),
    product_id: get("product_id"),
    product_name: get("product_name"),
    product_code: get("product_code"),
    ean_code: get("ean_code"),
    hsn_code: get("hsn_code"),
    brand_id: get("brand_id"),
    brand_name: get("brand_name"),
    shipped_qty: Number(get("shipped_qty") || 0),
    selling_rate: Number(get("selling_rate") || 0),
    mrp: Number(get("mrp") || 0),
    tax_percent: Number(get("tax_percent") || 0),
    tax_amount: Number(get("tax_amount") || 0),
    gross_amount: Number(get("gross_amount") || 0),
    scheme_amount: Number(get("scheme_amount") || 0),
    discount_percent: Number(get("discount_percent") || 0),
    discount_amount: Number(get("discount_amount") || 0),
    taxable_sales_value: Number(get("taxable_sales_value") || 0),
    net_sales_value: Number(get("net_sales_value") || 0),
    batch_id: get("batch_id"),
    batch_code: get("batch_code"),
    expiry_date: get("expiry_date"),
    tier_applied: get("tier_applied")
  };
}
